verdict.rationale: BugSnag documents per-project dashboard views that cover part of this story. You can filter the dashboard by release to see which release introduced errors, and timeline release annotations correlate new versions with error-rate changes. It also offers an 'introduced in the last 24 hours' view, stability tracking against targets, and grouping that surfaces the highest-impact issues. Nothing shows dashboards that aggregate trends across multiple projects or teams, and there is no explicit top-regressions view. The Data Access API is only a building block for such views and earns no credit. Missing for 10: cross-project/team aggregated dashboards, explicit top-regressions view, independent corroboration of trend dashboards.
